content.text: Please refresh the page to get the latest updates.Refreshwaiting list/ˈweɪtɪŋ lɪst/Nouna list of people waiting for a service, medical treatment, etc.We're on the waiting list to join the golf club.There's a waiting list of up to 10 weeks for the dish.See LessonWaiting in line, sitting in the middle seat, the food, delays — there's a long list of annoying things about flying on planes.See LessonAnd while the airship — expected to be an HAV vehicle — hasn't even been bought or certified to fly yet, waiting list tickets are available.See LessonOpenAI said it is testing the service on users outside Europe, and people can join the waiting list if they'd like to try it out.See LessonA local librarian told CNN that, by early February, there were 135 people on the waiting list to borrow The Adventures of Dillon Helbig's Crismis.See LessonGiraffe Hall at Port Lympne Hotel & Reserve does not yet have an opening date, but already has over 9,000 people on its waiting list.See LessonMark's waiting for me.See LessonWaiting in a hot tureen!See LessonMy dog is waiting.See LessonIs he waiting for someone?See LessonABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ000
